title: Daylight Dynamics
description: Mod that lets you manipulate day length
body:
This mod lets you manipulate day length.

**Mod setup:**


_Before 26.4.1:_
- /daylength mode custom/timezone (to set in which mode it works).
- /daylength start/stop (to run the mod).


_After 26.4.1:_
- **IN 26.4.1 to setup mod you need to use /daylightdynamics command and adjust settings in new GUI**

## Features

* Fully customizable day length
* Timezone synchronization
* Real-world clock syncing
* Server-side control over time progression
* Compatible sleeping mechanics even when using custom day lengths

---

## Time Modes

### Timezone Mode

Synchronizes Minecraft time with your server's local time, creating a seamless connection between the game world and real life.

### Custom Mode

Set your own day length anywhere from **1 minute** up to **24 hours and 59 minutes**, allowing you to create anything from fast-paced gameplay to highly immersive long-day experiences.

---

## Commands

### Versions before 26.4.1

* `/daylength`

  * Available modes: `custom`, `timezone`

### Versions 26.4.1 and newer

* `/daylightdynamics`

  * Opens the in-game configuration GUI

---

## Perfect For

* Role-play servers that require longer, more realistic days
* SMP servers focused on immersion
* Realism and simulation-based modpacks
* Content creators and cinematic builders
* Survival players who want more daylight for exploration and building

---

## Why use Daylight Dynamics?

Vanilla Minecraft uses a fixed day-night cycle that may not fit every playstyle.

Daylight Dynamics gives server owners and players the flexibility to match real-world time, extend daylight hours, or create entirely custom schedules without disrupting core gameplay mechanics such as sleeping.
